problema.title: What happens when you manage
problema.intro: Buying Ca'n Ros was the right move for growth. However, behind the counter, we are working twice as hard to keep it afloat. The methods that worked for one store are now a bottleneck: a 'silent disorder' that steals our sales hours.
problema.pain1Desc: Day-to-day work is lost to emergencies: chasing a mismatched delivery note or looking for lost material, instead of organizing the store or planning.
problema.pain2Desc: Comparing prices and stock between Palma and Campos using memory and spreadsheets. It is exhausting work, prone to errors, and slows down agility.
problema.pain3Title: Lost sales due to lack of control
problema.pain3Desc: Not everything that should be sold is sold due to pure disorganization. Unrecorded stockouts, messy products, and a lack of clear processes cost money daily.

solucion.desc: An internal IT Department takes over the robotic work. Let systems compare prices and monitor stock so your best talent can do what no one else can: advise, build loyalty, and close sales.
solucion.antes1: Chasing lost delivery notes and finding where the mismatch originated
solucion.despues1: Mismatches and incidents detected automatically in 3 seconds
solucion.antes2: Cross-referencing rates from both stores by exporting data manually to Excel
solucion.despues2: Price comparison agent working continuously in the background
solucion.antes3: Discovering we run out of a product when the customer asks for it
solucion.despues3: Predictive warning system that alerts us before a stockout

perfil.title: The value of the Hybrid Profile
perfil.intro:
The biggest mistake companies make is separating those who design technology from those who suffer it daily. My proposal is not to be just another salesperson or a technician locked in an office.

My goal is to be the bridge between both worlds:

Someone capable of detecting the problem on the ground, and with the technical ability to solve it by creating custom tools.

mostradorItems.title: Understand the business from within
mostradorItems.desc: Serve the professional at the counter to know the **catalog and real demand** firsthand.

mostradorItems.title: Map the operations
mostradorItems.desc: Work in the warehouse to detect **real operational bottlenecks** in stock flows.

mostradorItems.title: Diagnose
mostradorItems.desc: Accurately identify which repetitive tasks are **stealing valuable sales time** from managers.

procesosItems.title: Intelligent automation
procesosItems.desc: Deploy **AI Agents** to take over data processing and mechanical tasks.

procesosItems.title: Precision tools
procesosItems.desc: Develop **custom IT solutions** solving tangible day-to-day challenges in store.

procesosItems.title: Data unification
procesosItems.desc: Cross-reference and analyze data from **Palma and Campos** to facilitate decision-making for Management.

garantias.title: Three guarantees
garantias.desc: Technology exists to add agility, never to create uncertainty. Every automation is built around safety, control, and zero friction for Management.
garantias.g1Desc: No process runs autonomously. Technology creates suggestions and drafts; final validation is always yours.
garantias.g2Desc: POS, ERP, and banking are managed by certified providers. I add automation and intelligence layers without altering the core.
garantias.g3Desc: Any implemented tool can be toggled on or off in seconds. Operations never stop or depend on a single tool.

areas.title: Structure of

viabilidad.title: Implementation
viabilidad.desc: No unrealistic promises. A pragmatic roadmap to evolve the company organically from within the store itself.
viabilidad.inversion75: Covered by hybrid internal role (no-code tools, standard AI models)
viabilidad.inversion25: Requires external investment (certified ERP/POS specialist, licenses)
viabilidad.tiempoNota: Humans remain essential in the loop. We just stop wasting time typing repetitive data.
viabilidad.riesgo1: Zero risk. Systems strictly prepare drafts for human approval.
viabilidad.riesgo2: 100% reversible. Can be turned off within 1 minute.
viabilidad.riesgo3: Month one will focus on cleaning catalog codes and price matrices.
